walkthroughs.body_html:
Theme 3: Immigration and the Multicultural French Society — a core area of A-Level French.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Theme 3: Immigration and the Multicultural French Society brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Theme 3: Immigration and the Multicultural French Society.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which French verb form correctly says 'I would have helped' (j'... aidé)?
options: aurai
aurais
avait
étais

mcqs.q: Which conjunction always triggers the subjunctive?
options: parce que
car
bien que
puisque
J'utilise mon ordinateur quand le téléphone sonne.
Masculine.
Feminine (because it ends in -e).
It has no gender.

mcqs.q: How do you describe weather in the past, e.g. 'it was sunny'?
options: Imperfect - 'Il faisait beau' (descriptive past state).
J'utilise mon ordinateur quand le téléphone sonne.
Present - 'Il fait beau'.
Passé composé - 'Il a fait beau' (which suggests a completed event).

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I was using my computer when the phone rang' in French?
options: J'ai utilisé mon ordinateur quand le téléphone a sonné.
J'utilise mon ordinateur quand le téléphone sonne.
It has no gender.
J'utilisais mon ordinateur quand le téléphone a sonné.
